_comment: Reference set for the mutator grammar. One fixture, Python only -- every fixture we have is Python, so the grammar's LANGUAGE-DERIVED comment syntax (# vs // vs --) is NOT tested here. Task mix is weighted by the mined frequencies in docs/mutator-grammar.md: addComment/addArg/wrapCall heaviest, wrapInTry in both single- and multi-handler form. Every selector is validated by execution before use.
